title: Even Better Server Owner
description: Server management mod with moderation tools, datapack manager, and Modrinth integration. Compatible with Even Better Server Guardian.
body:
## What's new in v1.0.1

- Removed `/modrinth install` command — search and info remain available

# Even Better Server Owner

A server-side management mod that gives server owners powerful tools to moderate players and manage their server — all from in-game commands.

## Moderation
- `/warn <player> <reason>` / `/warnings` / `/clearwarnings` — warn players; auto-kick at configurable threshold
- `/mute <player> [duration] [reason]` / `/unmute` — time-limited or permanent mutes (`1h`, `30m`, `7d`, `perm`)
- `/tempban <player> <duration> <reason>` — temp-ban using the vanilla ban system
- `/freeze <player>` / `/unfreeze` — lock a player in place
- `/vanish` — toggle invisibility for operators
- `/staff` — list all online operators (open to everyone)
- `/history <player>` — view full punishment history

## Plugin & Server Management
- `/datamanager list/enable/disable/reload` — manage datapacks in-game without file system access
- `/serverstatus mods` — list all loaded mods with versions
- `/serverstatus server` — player count, MC version, and TPS
- `/serverconfig list/get/set` — read and write `server.properties` from in-game
- `/modrinth search <query>` — search Modrinth for mods and datapacks
- `/modrinth info <slug>` — view project details

## Compatibility with Even Better Server Guardian

When **[Even Better Server Guardian](https://modrinth.com/mod/even-better-server-guardian) v1.1+** is installed alongside this mod, `/serverstatus server` displays live TPS data pulled directly from Guardian's monitor. Install both for complete server oversight.
